records.translation: Tablas de mediciones para el ajuste

records.key: Choose the measurement tables and feature classes the model is fitted on, and the images it writes suggestions onto: the images on screen, all images, or chosen pages.
records.source: Choose the measurement tables and feature classes the model is fitted on, and the images it writes suggestions onto: the images on screen, all images, or chosen pages.
records.translation: Elija las tablas de mediciones y las clases de características con las que se ajusta el modelo, y las imágenes en las que escribe sugerencias: las imágenes en pantalla, todas las imágenes o las páginas elegidas.

records.key: Could not read the measurement tables: {why}
records.source: Could not read the measurement tables: {why}
records.translation: No se pudieron leer las tablas de mediciones: {why}

records.key: Stop the suggestion run at its next step. No new suggestions are written if it stops before the writing step; earlier suggestions are put back, and round scores may have been updated. Your annotations are unchanged. Shown only while a run is going.
records.source: Stop the suggestion run at its next step. No new suggestions are written if it stops before the writing step; earlier suggestions are put back, and round scores may have been updated. Your annotations are unchanged. Shown only while a run is going.
records.translation: Detenga la generación de sugerencias en el siguiente paso. No se escriben nuevas sugerencias si se detiene antes del paso de escritura; las sugerencias anteriores se restauran y puede que las puntuaciones de la ronda se hayan actualizado. Sus anotaciones no cambian. Solo se muestra durante una ejecución.
